items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: a telephone call from Dick Gibson, from Denver, and he just hired me again, for his 1979 jazz party

ctx.x: I'm going to attempt to do a couple of like -- I have to skipover so much and not get deeply into the subject, but I want to get into the subject of some of the jazz parties that are spin offs from the Gibson parties, and I'm gonna start, as Milt Hinton will agree with me, I'm sure -- the next big one for us was the Odessa jazz party. So I'll get into that one now.

My thoughts were just interrupted here -- a telephone call from Dick Gibson, from Denver, and he just hired me again, for his 1979 jazz party at the Broadmore Hotel in Colorado Springs this coming Labor Day weekend, and this will be my 17th year. I consider that a pretty good average!
Now for the Odessa party. For the past two years, we've missed the original ingredient for the Odessa party. I'll go on to explain.
